name: Directed Distance Fields (DDF)
definition: A Visibility Field (VF) ξ is View Consistent (VC) iff there exists a shape S such that S induces ξ. It acts as a per-ray indicator function rather than a complete representation.
summary: Directed Distance Fields are 5D neural representations mapping oriented points to visibility and distance, enabling fast, differentiable geometric rendering with a single forward pass per query.
